get_model_reranker: create a BertReranker model instance from a parameters dict for entity linking reranking
rerank_mentions: rerank candidate entities for a list of mentions using the BertReranker model
train_reranker: train the BertReranker model on labeled mention candidate pairs with an optimizer and scheduler
get_tokenizer: get a BERT tokenizer from pretrained model parameters for tokenizing mention and candidate text
process_mentions_for_model: process mentions into tensor data and features ready for the BERT reranking model
